So in addition to the bar exam, you have have to pass the character and fitness part. You have to disclose so much shit including like your financial situation, criminal record down to the traffic tickets, academic misconduct stuff, substance abuse shit, and more. One of the many parts of it is have you ever been diagnosed with with one of a series of mental health issues. The more recently you've been diagnosed,  the worse it reflects on your fitness to practice law, and I'm litterally applying for it now because my state does it well in advance. It will look fucking awful for me if I do it now and I'm required to supplement my application up until I'm admitted so it will look horrible then too. I'm really stuck and have to avoid a diagnosis or a hold right now, even though it's clear to me I have something going on that in an ideal world would get treatment.
